SiteHomePhone.dc.html.title: Website home page on a phone

n_PackageDrop.text: The Marketplace page with package installs. Press Simulate drag to see the full-panel drop overlay, then step through the flow with the buttons or the stage Tweak (idle, dragging, found, wrong-file). The found dialog needs the risk box ticked before Add is enabled. Tweaks: accent, motion, stage. Everything here is a design; nothing is implemented or verified yet.

n_PackageDropWide.text: The same install flow at desktop width, with the store grid behind the overlay and dialog. Try the stage Tweak and the Simulate drag button; resize to see the grid wrap. Tweaks: accent, motion, stage. Everything here is a design; nothing is implemented or verified yet.

n_PackageUpdates.text: Installed packages, one card each, covering every update state: up to date, update available with notes, updating with progress, restart needed, and update failed with the reason and the old version kept. Flip the Update automatically switches and press Update or Retry. Tweaks: accent, motion. Everything here is a design; nothing is implemented or verified yet.

n_SiteHome.text: The public website home page listing all seven integrations, each card carrying its own colour and motif. Try the light and dark switch in the header or the dark Tweak, and hover the cards. Tweaks: accent, motion, dark. Everything here is a design; nothing is implemented or verified yet.

n_SiteHomePhone.text: The same home page at phone width: one column, full-width download buttons, scrolls inside the frame. Try the dark Tweak. Tweaks: accent, motion, dark. Everything here is a design; nothing is implemented or verified yet.

n_BinDayPage.text: The Bin day page on the integrations website: what it does, setup, entities created, options, install by drag and drop, and the changelog. Kerbside identity: asphalt black and high-visibility lime, Big Shoulders Display with Public Sans, a week-strip calendar and wheelie-bin icons. Tweaks: accent, motion. Everything here is a design; nothing is implemented or verified yet.

n_BinDayCard.text: How Bin day looks inside Home Assistant: its entities on a dashboard card and its options dialog, in the dark house style with this integration's accent and motif. Tap a stream to change which collection is next, and open Options to change the schedule. Tweaks: accent, motion. Everything here is a design; nothing is implemented or verified yet.

n_EdgeTtsPage.text: The Edge TTS page on the integrations website: what it does, setup, entities created, options with a sample speak action, install by drag and drop, and the changelog. Sound-desk identity: deep petrol with a signal rose accent on ice white, Syne with Atkinson Hyperlegible, a row of moving sound bars and channel-strip level meters. Press Speak or Stop to start and rest the bars, and tap a language chip to change the sample voice. No sound is played. Tweaks: accent, motion. Everything here is a design; nothing is implemented or verified yet.

n_EdgeTtsCard.text: How Edge TTS looks inside Home Assistant: the Text to speech dialog for a media player, in the dark house style with this integration's accent and sound-bar motif. Search the voices, filter by language, move the speed and pitch sliders, then press Speak to step through generating and playing. Turn on Simulate no connection and press Speak to see the error, or jump to any state with the stage Tweak (idle, generating, playing, error). Open Options for the defaults dialog. No sound is played. Tweaks: accent, motion, stage. Everything here is a design; nothing is implemented or verified yet.
